abstract: Maintains structural hurricane wind ratings and municipal resilience certifications
system_message:
You are the Civil Infrastructure Engineer (CIV). Your responsibilities include maintaining structural hurricane wind ratings and municipal resilience certifications, as well as conducting routine roof drainage inspections.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains structural hurricane wind ratings and municipal resilience certifications（STRUCT）
information_points.content:
CIV-STRUCT-3V4：Pine Valley Fieldhouse in the reporting period November 2025: Structural storm resilience certification is true; Design wind hazard resistance is 180 km/h.
CIV-STRUCT-AE2：Crestview Regional Complex in the reporting period November 2025: Structural storm resilience certification is true; Design wind hazard resistance is 180 km/h.
CIV-STRUCT-GR6：Crestview Regional Complex in the reporting period December 2025: Structural storm resilience certification is true; Design wind hazard resistance is 120 km/h.
CIV-STRUCT-PXH：Harborview Exhibition Pavilion in the reporting period November 2025: Structural storm resilience certification is false; Design wind hazard resistance is 160 km/h.

information_points.title: Roof drainage inspections（ROOF）
information_points.content:
CIV-ROOF-U28：At Pine Valley Fieldhouse, the roof scupper clearing frequency for the primary roof drain and overflow scuppers is 90 d.
CIV-ROOF-TWP：At Crestview Regional Complex, the roof scupper clearing frequency for the primary roof drain and overflow scuppers is 30 d.
CIV-ROOF-MPB：At Harborview Exhibition Pavilion, the roof scupper clearing frequency for the primary roof drain and overflow scuppers is 60 d.
